description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (3000)] and [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)], grants [Synchro Mode] and [Cheering Mode] to the user

description.name: Repeating Samba
description.text: Causes [DEF and RES -50% (15s)]/[ATK and MAG -50% (15s)] every 1+2n/2+2n activations, grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Healing Samba
description.text: Restores 1500 HP, grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: HP Stock (3000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 3000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Cheering Mode
description.text: Grants [Dualcast Dancer 1] to the character and [Dualcast Prismatic 1] to all other allies after using Repeating Samba, removed after triggering

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
